title: Risk overlay: security-sensitive work
description: Pentesting, exploit development, credential testing, C2 tooling, or any dual-use security tool.

rules.title: Dual-use security work requires a recorded authorization context
rules.purpose: Distinguish authorized security testing/research from unauthorized attack tooling.
rules.requirement: scope.assumptions or brief.context must record the authorization context (pentest engagement, CTF, security research, or defensive use) before dual-use tooling is built or run.
rules.evidence_requirement: The contract states the authorization context in plain language.
rules.source_or_rationale: Platform safety rules: dual-use security tools require clear authorization context.

rules.title: No destructive techniques, DoS, or mass targeting
rules.purpose: Keep security work within defensive/authorized-testing bounds.
rules.requirement: No denial-of-service technique, mass-target scanning, supply-chain compromise, or detection-evasion-for-malicious-purposes may be produced, regardless of stated authorization.
rules.evidence_requirement: A review of the deliverable confirms none of these categories are present.
rules.source_or_rationale: Platform safety rules: prohibited destructive/DoS/mass-targeting/evasion categories.
